seo.title: Download TablePro
seo.description: Download TablePro, with separate builds for Apple silicon and Intel, or install it with Homebrew. The iPhone and iPad app is on the App Store.

header.title: Download TablePro
header.lead: Choose a build for your device.

homebrew.title: Homebrew
homebrew.body: Homebrew installs the build for your Mac’s chip. After that, the app keeps itself up to date.
homebrew.trails: Homebrew’s copy is updated separately and can trail a new release. If it installs an older version, choose <ui>TablePro > Check for Updates…</ui> to get the current one.

ios.body: A free app for {devices}, with its own set of features.

install.title: Install and first run
steps: Drag TablePro into the Applications folder.
Open TablePro from Applications. Choose <ui>Open</ui> when macOS asks you to confirm.
Add a connection, or try the bundled Chinook SQLite database through <ui>Help > Open Sample Database</ui>.
install.signing: Both builds are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so you don’t need to change any security setting to open TablePro.
install.drivers: Common drivers are bundled. Others need an internet connection to download on first use and update separately from the app.

updates.title: Updates
paragraphs: TablePro checks for updates once a day. A new version downloads in the background and installs the next time you quit the app.
Most releases reach Macs in stages over about a day and a half. To get one sooner, choose <ui>TablePro > Check for Updates…</ui>

You can turn off automatic checks or automatic installs in <ui>Settings > General</ui>. Update checks go to GitHub, where releases are published, and every update is signed and verified before it installs.

otherPlatforms.title: Other platforms
otherPlatforms.body: TablePro is not available for {platforms}, and there is no release date.

olderVersions.title: Older versions and release notes
olderVersions.body: Every release, with its notes and both disk images, is on GitHub Releases. The changelog lists what changed in each version.
